scope: Align the in-memory default for absent AcDbEvalExpr.parentId on two exact AC1024 typed DXF profiles with an independent DXF importer's default. This does not add a DXF field or establish dynamic-block semantics.

physicalInput.relevantSourceObservation: The existing source-bound receipt identifies BLOCKLINEARGRIP 0x1111 with EvalExpr.parentId 0xFFFFFFFF. The prior fresh DXF readback was 0; the follow-up physical control now requires the same in-memory default after isolated ASCII and Binary typed readback.

independentPeerSource.observation: The importer initializes Dwg_EvalExpr.parentid to -1 before reading its supported DXF groups. The inspected function has no parentid group-code case. The inspected out_dxf.c blob contains no parentid reference.
independentPeerSource.evidenceLimit: This is an independent implementation's import default, not a normative Autodesk DXF field definition and not proof that omitting the DWG value preserves native evaluation semantics.

implementation.change: The exact AC1024 oriented-grip and visibility-parameter DXF body decoders now assign UINT32_MAX for the absent EvalExpr.parentId default, matching LibreDWG's -1 initialization instead of DRW::NoHandle (0). Output wire groups are unchanged; no speculative group code was added.
implementation.compatibility: The source model retains its original DWG parentId. Only fresh typed DXF import state for the two covered body branches is normalized.

focusedCtest.coverage: Generated ASCII/Binary output and fresh typed readback assert UINT32_MAX for the unrepresented parentId default in oriented-grip and visibility-parameter profiles. The oriented-grip test covers alignment, flip, and linear subclasses. Existing exact wire, destination-preservation, malformed-record, and same-writer retry controls remain active.

physicalSourceCheck.result: PASS: 2 alignment, 3 flip, and 4 linear source grips; exact DXF wire and fresh typed ASCII/Binary readback. The source-bound BLOCKLINEARGRIP handle 0x1111 is required to carry parentId UINT32_MAX, and the typed readback control requires that same normalized import default.
